scheduler: Complete forward/reverse point-candidate incidence reconstructed each step; global dead first, global forced next, then minimum degree among equal generation-zero roots. Neutral seeded ID permutation, seed 31.
rollback: Immutable selected prefix, full graph reconstruction. Guard activation increments version and replays the whole prefix and graph.
learning: Cold online candidate-specific failure guards. A fresh unmarked complete point probe with only that candidate fixed supplies proof. Exhaustion activates boundary value 0 versus candidate value 1. Unknown probes add no assignments. Context-only failures stay branch-local.
proofScope: Exact finite catalog, horizon, fixed coordinate frame, target, direction, face region and edge cap only. No transfer, no saved prior import, no global inequivalence conclusion.
